sophie (People Ops): Quick Q — I have a claim with EUR invoices + one taxi w/o receipt. Also hotel incidentals on personal card. What's needed for VAT reclaim and per-diem offset?

alex: For VAT we need the supplier VAT number on the invoice + the original invoice PDF (card machine slips are not sufficient). If the hotel folio lists VAT, upload that instead of the booking confirmation.

marta: For the missing taxi receipt — attach a photo of the taxi meter or a screenshot from the app plus the credit card transaction line, and add a short note with time and route. Policy allows exceptions up to €50 with manager approval.

dan: Company card covered nights 1–2; I paid night 3 personally because the booking agent charged the wrong card. Can I split the hotel expense across two claims?

sophie (People Ops): Yes — submit two separate hotel expenses. For the night you paid, mark it as `personal_payment` and attach the folio + the company booking confirmation/screenshot. We need the corporate attempt evidence to approve the split.

alex: :thinking_face: About per-diem — EMEA per-diem is a daily maximum in local currency. If you have itemized meal receipts we reimburse actuals up to policy. If you use per-diem, indicate which days had meals included (e.g., conference dinner) so we can subtract those amounts.

marta: Note on VAT: cross-border train/air tickets usually don’t carry reclaimable VAT. Hotel and restaurant VAT are reclaimable if the supplier invoice shows VAT number and tax line.

dan: Cash tips — I paid some tips in cash and didn't get receipts. How do I claim?

sophie (People Ops): Cash tips: small amounts (<= €10/day) can be claimed with an attestation and manager sign-off using the `cash_tip_attestation` checkbox. Anything above that needs a receipt. Add a short note on reason/time/vendor.

alex: If receipts are in PLN/GBP/EUR, upload the original and also attach the FX transaction or screenshot of the card statement. The expense portal can auto-convert if you select the bank rate; otherwise include the exchange rate used.

expense-bot: Reminder — supported formats: PDF, JPG, PNG. Max file size 10MB. Missing receipt will set status to `needs_info` and block reimbursement.

marta: I'll submit the two hotel claims and attach the taxi meter photo. tagging @sophie for the manager exception approval.

sophie (People Ops): Provisional approved — please add the taxi photo and put a 1-line comment about route/time. I'll route the VATable invoices to finance for reclaim instructions. If finance needs supplier VAT numbers, I'll follow up.

alex: If anyone else hits the same booking-agent-card mixup, DM travel@redwood and keep the booking screenshots — they speed approvals.
